signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION ZLANGE( NORM, M, N, A, LDA, WORK )

params.name: norm
params.reference: Specifies the value to be returned in ZLANGE as described above.

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$. When $M = 0$, ZLANGE is set to zero.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$. When $N = 0$, ZLANGE is set to zero.

params.name: A
params.reference: The m by n matrix A.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (M,1)$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: where $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge M$ when `NORM = 'I'`; otherwise, `WORK` is not referenced.

notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace WORK
